Name: Nemuri as Abigail
Author: TheDevilRoll
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Nemuri Kayama is not my original character, all rights go to Kōhei Horikoshi and Hideyuki Furuhashi [/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]She's finally finished! after a block and some procrastinating i finally completed Nemuri Kayama as Abigail. This is a full replacement mod that replaces Abigail's portraits and sprites to change her into Midnight. I thought she deserved some love as part of the rooftop gang. This for now is a replacement mod as I'm still learning to make an expansion.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]I chose the suit she wears in vigilantes as her everyday as i loved that outfit, she looked so cute in it. I also gave her a winter outfit as the sweater dress she wore in a scene talking on the phone. Her spring dance outfit is based off her undercover outfit, all in all i hope you enjoy them.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][b]Dialogue can be changed using the "My Hero Valley Conversion" Mod that is uploaded. Abigial's name is changed to Nemuri. This mod will convert dialogue and names when called to their names. for example Sebastian will be labeled as Sho (Nickname) or Shouta depending on if a character would usually say Sebby or Sebastian. Nemuri will be Nemuri or Nem. Hizashi as Hizashi or Zashi etc. If you don't want to use my other two mods (Hizashi as Sam or Aizawa as Sebastian) you can use GCGM, there are options to turn their names off.[/b][/color]

If you have requests about characters please let me know! i do have some characters already planned (Gus as lunch rush, Willy as Selkie, and Oboro as Krobus?)
[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]1. Install SMAPI
2. Install Content Patcher
3. Extract this mod into your Stardew Valley Mods folder
4. Launch the game using SMAPI  [/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Changes the Portrait and Sprite of Abigail[/color]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI (4.4.0 or later)
Content Patcher (2.90 or better) [/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Thank you to my best friend who saw me going through this journey. Thank you to anyone who downloads this mod, it makes me feel very grateful.[/color]
